p3-s1: Sancho went home so happy that Teresa was puzzled:
What’s all this joy about, my dear?
p3-s2: I’m going off again with my master, my sweet Teresa!
p3-s3: Now we’re famous, and my island is closer than ever!
p3-s4: Teresa sighed and straightened her husband’s collar:
I don’t need an island, Sancho.
p3-s5: What I need is for you to come back in one piece.
